sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which yoga pose resembles a tree and helps improve your balance?
In the traditional game of Kabaddi, what word must the raider chant continuously without breaking their breath?
Why is deep breathing important while practicing Yoga?
options: A) It makes you run much faster
B) It calms the mind and relaxes the body
C) It helps you shout louder during games
questions.answer: B) It calms the mind and relaxes the body

questions.question_text: Which of these is a popular traditional tag game in India where players sit in a straight row facing opposite directions?
What is the main benefit of performing Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutation) daily?
options: A) It makes the body stiff
B) It improves overall flexibility and strength
C) It helps you fall asleep immediately
questions.answer: B) It improves overall flexibility and strength

questions.question_text: In games like Hide and Seek (Luka Chuppi), what skill is used the most?
options: C) Quiet observation and quick movement
questions.answer: C) Quiet observation and quick movement

questions.question_text: What does the word 'Asana' mean in Yoga?
options: B) A type of healthy food

questions.question_text: How should you properly end a Yoga practice session to relax your muscles?
options: A) By jumping high in the air
B) By resting peacefully in Shavasana (Corpse Pose)
C) By eating a heavy meal immediately
D) By playing a fast game of Kabaddi
questions.answer: B) By resting peacefully in Shavasana (Corpse Pose)

questions.question_text: Which traditional childhood game involves spinning a pointed wooden object using a piece of string?
What is the most important thing to remember to avoid injuries while playing outdoor traditional games?
options: B) Following the rules and playing fairly
questions.answer: B) Following the rules and playing fairly

questions.question_text: Why is warming up important before doing yoga or playing traditional games? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Warming up gently stretches your muscles and prepares your body for physical activity. It helps prevent injuries and makes you more flexible during the game.

questions.question_text: Describe how to play 'Langdi' (one-leg hopping game) safely with your friends. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: In Langdi, one player hops on a single leg to tag others. To play safely, avoid pushing, hop carefully to keep your balance, and play on soft, even ground.

questions.question_text: What is the correct and healthy way to sit while practicing breathing exercises (Pranayama)? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Sit cross-legged on a flat mat with a straight back, relaxed shoulders, and eyes gently closed. Keep your hands resting softly on your knees.

questions.question_text: Name two important values you learn by playing team games like Kho-Kho. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Playing team games like Kho-Kho teaches us the importance of teamwork and quick decision-making. We also learn respect for our teammates and the rules of fair play.

questions.question_text: How does practicing the Butterfly Pose (Baddha Konasana) help our body? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The Butterfly Pose helps in stretching the inner thighs and knees. It improves overall flexibility in the legs and helps us sit comfortably on the floor for a longer time.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are explaining the traditional game of 'Gilli Danda' to someone who has never seen it. Describe the wooden equipment used. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Gilli Danda is played using two wooden sticks. The 'Danda' is a long, strong stick used for striking. The 'Gilli' is a small, oval-shaped piece of wood with tapered ends. The player hits the edge of the Gilli with the Danda to make it flip high into the air.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are performing the Lotus Pose (Padmasana) in a quiet, green garden. Describe your body posture and how you feel inside. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I am sitting gracefully with my right foot resting on my left thigh and my left foot on my right thigh. My back is completely straight, and my breathing is slow. Surrounded by nature, my mind feels completely calm, focused, and deeply relaxed.

questions.question_text: Describe the step-by-step action of a 'raider' entering the opponent's court in Kabaddi. Mention their breathing and movement. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The raider takes a deep breath and steps into the opponent's half, continuously chanting "Kabaddi, Kabaddi" without stopping. They move swiftly and stay low, using quick footwork to dodge defenders. They try to tag an opponent with their hand or foot and immediately dash back across the midline to safety before running out of breath.

questions.question_text: Explain the proper sequence to perform the Tree Pose (Vrikshasana) and explain how you maintain your balance without falling over. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, stand perfectly straight. Slowly lift your right foot and place the sole firmly against your inner left thigh. Once balanced, bring your hands together in front of your chest like a prayer, then slowly raise them above your head. To stay steady, I focus my eyes on a single still point directly in front of me.
